scope: Ranked replay-boundary runtime: strings/filesystem, map metadata, GameInfo/GameSlot, Xfer memory files, containers, camera, and sockets

applied.name: GameInfo_IsLocalSlot
applied.evidence: Bounds-checks a slot index and compares it with GameInfo's local slot.
applied.basis: field offset, nine callers, slot-index range

applied.name: MapTransfer_ResetRuntimeSubsystems
applied.evidence: Resets network, engine, UI, display, and related subsystems after a map-transfer transition.
applied.basis: global singleton virtual calls and all replay/map-transfer callers

applied.name: GameSlot_CopyAssign
applied.evidence: Copies the complete 0x5C-byte GameSlot, using owned-string assignment for its name fields.
applied.basis: field-for-field copy, recovered GameSlot layout, assignment callers

applied.name: GameInfo_Dtor
applied.evidence: Destroys eight embedded 0x5C-byte GameSlots and then the GameInfo/Snapshot base.
applied.basis: array destructor stride/count, named GameInfo vtable teardown

applied.name: UnicodeString_FromTwoOperandConcatExpression
applied.evidence: Materializes a two-operand lazy Unicode concatenation into owned UTF-16 storage.
applied.basis: two operand lengths, UTF-16 allocation/copy, replay filename callers

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_SetMapName
applied.evidence: Publishes the transferred map name to APT:FileTransferLoadingMapName.
applied.basis: exact APT key, string conversion, map-transfer callers

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_UpdateProgress
applied.evidence: Updates a mapped player's status text and emits the APT SetBarTo progress event.
applied.basis: popup row map, FileTransfer::Status key, SetBarTo arguments

applied.name: UnicodeString_FindChar
applied.evidence: Returns the first matching UTF-16 character pointer or null.
applied.basis: owned UnicodeString length header and complete linear scan

applied.name: MapCache_GetMapDirectory
applied.evidence: Builds the internal or user Maps directory according to map-cache build mode.
applied.basis: Data\\Maps\\Internal, user-data path, Maps component, callers

applied.name: MapMetaData_GetDisplayName
applied.evidence: Resolves and caches a map's localized display name with map.str and save-game fallbacks.
applied.basis: map.str, TheGameText calls, MG:RTSSaveGameName, MapMetaData callers

applied.name: MapCache_WriteCacheINI
applied.evidence: Writes MapCache.ini entries, metadata, waypoints, tech/supply positions, and player positions.
applied.basis: instruction/string-for-source match to SAGE1 MapCache::writeCacheINI

applied.name: ListNode32Sentinel_Initialize
applied.evidence: Allocates a 32-byte list sentinel and self-links both directions.
applied.basis: allocation size, self-link stores, seven container callers

applied.name: Scheduler_SubmitCallback
applied.evidence: Submits a callback through the active scheduler object when it is in the accepting state.
applied.basis: scheduler pointer/state guard and sole automatic-recording caller

applied.name: RandomSubsystem_InitializeStreams
applied.evidence: Initializes three deterministic random-stream state arrays and their shared seed state.
applied.basis: three state-array writes, fixed recurrence constants, initialization callers

applied.name: UserData_BuildDocumentsDirectory
applied.evidence: Builds the localized game user-data directory beneath CSIDL_PERSONAL and appends separators.
applied.basis: SHGetSpecialFolderPathW, localized leaf helper, replay directory callers

applied.name: ReplayRecording_UpdateAutoState
applied.evidence: Advances recorder automatic state from engine/network state and encoder-finalization readiness.
applied.basis: recorder fields, TheRecorder transitions, four recording callers

applied.name: ReplayRecording_HandleAutoScheduledRecord
applied.evidence: Writes an automatically scheduled record immediately when possible, otherwise deep-copies and queues it; null signals update completion.
applied.basis: writer submission, 12-byte record copy, queue insertion, null callback path

applied.name: ReplayObjectRefVector_DestroyStorage
applied.evidence: Releases a range of replay object references and frees its vector storage.
applied.basis: release-range helper, allocator pairing, 18 replay/voice callers

applied.name: ReplayRecording_AutoScheduleCallback
applied.evidence: Forwards the scheduled automatic-recording callback to the active recorder.
applied.basis: TheRecorder guard and sole replay-recording callback target

applied.name: ReplayRecording_ClearAutoQueueAndScheduleCallback
applied.evidence: Drains the automatic-recording queue, resets its state, and schedules the recorder callback.
applied.basis: queue ownership loop, state fields, callback target, exclusive replay caller

applied.name: GameInfo_SetInGameNotInProgress
applied.evidence: Sets GameInfo in-game true and in-progress false.
applied.basis: two flag writes and SAGE1 GameInfo state semantics

applied.name: GameInfo_GetSeed
applied.evidence: Returns the deterministic game seed.
applied.basis: recovered GameInfo offset and SAGE1 inline accessor/callers

applied.name: GameInfo_ClearSlotList
applied.evidence: Sets each of the eight existing GameSlots to SLOT_CLOSED.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to SAGE1 GameInfo::clearSlotList

applied.name: GameInfo_CopyAssign
applied.evidence: Deep copy-assigns complete GameInfo state, including eight owned GameSlots, map/version fields, and the optional extension.
applied.basis: eight-slot loop, GameSlot copy calls, GameInfo fields, 912-byte extension ownership

applied.name: Vector60_PushBack
applied.evidence: Copy-constructs a 60-byte element at end or grows the vector first.
applied.basis: 60-byte increment, capacity branch, four metadata callers

applied.name: CameraControllerManager_SetActiveCamera
applied.evidence: Deactivates the previous camera, switches the active index, activates the replacement, and applies its transform.
applied.basis: camera vtable calls, transform identity fallback, replay camera caller

applied.name: ListNode40Sentinel_Initialize
applied.evidence: Allocates a 40-byte list sentinel and self-links both directions.
applied.basis: allocation size, self-link stores, replay camera/container callers

applied.name: XferSave_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs XferSave with save mode, empty targets/stacks, and its named vtable.
applied.basis: named XferSave vtable, SAGE1 constructor semantics, save callers

applied.name: XferLoad_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs XferLoad with load mode, supplied memory/source fields, and its named vtable.
applied.basis: named XferLoad vtable, SAGE1 constructor semantics, load callers

applied.name: Xfer_Dtor
applied.evidence: Restores the Xfer base vtable during transfer-object destruction.
applied.basis: named Xfer vtable and derived load/save destruction call chains

applied.name: FileSystem_DoesFileExistW
applied.evidence: Converts a UTF-16 path to a bounded narrow path and tests it through the filesystem search path.
applied.basis: wide conversion, narrow existence helper, seven callers

applied.name: FileSystem_CreateDirectoryW
applied.evidence: Converts a UTF-16 path to a bounded narrow path and creates it with the requested recursion flags.
applied.basis: wide conversion, narrow recursive create helper, ten callers

applied.name: MemoryReadFile_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs a named MemoryReadFile over a supplied memory range.
applied.basis: named vtable, range fields, <MemoryReadFile> identifier

applied.name: MemoryReadFile_Create
applied.evidence: Allocates and constructs a 32-byte MemoryReadFile when the input range is valid.
applied.basis: allocation size, constructor call, five stream-load callers

applied.name: MemoryWriteFile_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs an empty MemoryWriteFile with an optional identifier.
applied.basis: named vtable, field initialization, <MemoryWriteFile> fallback

applied.name: MemoryWriteFile_Create
applied.evidence: Allocates and constructs a 44-byte MemoryWriteFile.
applied.basis: allocation size, constructor call, eight stream-save callers

applied.name: SetSockBlocking
applied.evidence: Sets a GameSpy socket blocking or nonblocking with FIONBIO and returns SDK success.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy gsPlatformSocket.c

applied.name: GSISocketSelect
applied.evidence: Polls one GameSpy socket for read, write, and exception readiness with a zero timeout.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy gsPlatformSocket.c

applied.name: SystemTime_GetLocal
applied.evidence: Writes the current local SYSTEMTIME.
applied.basis: single GetLocalTime call and replay timestamp callers

applied.name: SharedWorkerEvent_WaitOneMillisecond
applied.evidence: Poll-waits one millisecond on the shared worker synchronization handle.
applied.basis: exact WaitForSingleObject call and replay/map-transfer pump callers
